audit.why: Heimerdinger 56.09% over 271 games. Early and mid lane belong to the nest; side lane after two items belongs to Yorick (Maiden splitpush vs stationary turrets). Existing text already frames this.

audit.whatIsWrong: Level chart disagreed with the packet chart and with its own whys[] text on four rows (0, 3, 5, 6).
audit.why: whys[0] says 'neither side can commit, so it's even' but the row read Heimerdinger; whys[3] calls Levels 4-5 'your peak' but the row read Skill; whys[5] says you still out-trade at first item but the row read Skill; whys[6] says Yorick out-scales but the row read Heimerdinger. Packet levelChart is Skill/Heim/Heim/Heim/Heim/Heim/Yorick.
audit.corrected: Rows 0, 3, 5, 6 flipped to Skill, Heimerdinger, Heimerdinger, Yorick in both layers as one atomic group, with ratings matched.

audit.whatIsWrong: Last Rites (Q) is never named — neither its heal (anti-heal timing) nor its auto-attack reset (the real trade tell). Dark Procession is described only as a cage, never as destructible. No real cooldown numbers anywhere.
audit.why: Riot text: Last Rites deals bonus damage on his next attack and heals him — kit flags heal + autoReset. Dark Procession is 'a destructible wall'. Cooldowns: W 20/18/16/14/12, E 12/11/10/9/8, R 160/130/100; your E is 11s flat, R 100/85/70.
audit.corrected: Stun on the Last Rites wind-up (auto reset), not the ghoul leap; Oblivion Orb before extended trades; break the cage rather than sit in it; cooldown numbers added to the cooldown block.

audit.whatIsWrong: Packet defect: no cooldown-sequencing advice anywhere.
audit.why: Dark Procession at rank 1 is 20s down; that is the whole engage window.
audit.corrected: breakdown.cooldowns now carries 20s/12s W, 11s E, 100/85/70s R.

edits.before: - Yorick Dark Procession: matchup-defining — Traps you for ghouls. E-stun before it. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Dark Procession (W): 20s at rank 1, 12s maxed — the wall pins you in the swarm, so fight the moment it is spent. - CH-3X grenade: 11s flat — save the centre-stun for him, never for ghouls. - UPGRADE!!!: 100/85/70s — kill windows only.

edits.before: Traps you for ghouls. E-stun before it. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: The wall is 20s at rank 1 — bait it, then run the full nest pattern while it is down.

edits.before: Keep Yorick farming inside turret range, W-poke his step-ups, and E-stun the moment he commits into the nest.
edits.after: Keep him in turret range, W-poke step-ups, and E-stun on the Last Rites wind-up — the auto reset, not the ghoul leap.

edits.before: Trade strictly around Dark Procession: when it is down, run your full pattern; when it is up, give nothing. If behind, farm safe and let your spikes re-open the lane.
edits.after: Trade around Dark Procession: while the wall is down run your full pattern, while it is up give nothing. Last Rites heals him off every ghoul and minion, so buy Oblivion Orb before extended trades.

edits.before: That is Yorick's favourite window — refuse it and half his win condition is gone.
edits.after: The cage is destructible — break it and walk out before the ghoul swarm lands.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Maiden makes his autos hit harder — let the turret beams eat the ghouls.

notes: Level chart was wrong on four of seven rows in both layers; flipped as one atomic group to match the packet chart and the existing whys[] prose. Both _missing interactions (Last Rites heal -> anti-heal timing, Last Rites auto reset -> trade tell) are now on the page. Did not assert whether Heimerdinger's W rockets or E grenade pass over Dark Procession's wall — not in Riot's text, left unverified.
